web-guide-idea-15.audience: Railway enthusiasts and people who enjoy scenery and travel stories.
web-guide-idea-15.offer: Offer a window-seat travel diary from a permitted location. Set expectations about signal gaps and focus on the route rather than filming fellow passengers.
web-guide-idea-15.steps.0: Check applicable filming rules and choose privacy-conscious framing.
web-guide-idea-15.steps.1: Introduce the route and narrate changing scenery.
web-guide-idea-15.steps.2: Share railway memories at a stable point and close with the next stop.
web-guide-idea-15.equipment: A phone and power bank. Keep the device inside the carriage and avoid obstructing doors or other passengers.
web-guide-idea-15.returnReason: Follow different routes, landscapes or station stories. Your observations give repeat viewers more than another view through glass.
web-guide-idea-15.promotion: Share the route and a realistic coverage window. Do not promise an uninterrupted stream.
